decision_conditions:
S73 - CONSENT LIMITED TO THAT OF ORIGINAL PERMISSION: The development hereby permitted shall be begun not later than the expiration of 05 Dec 2025.

REASON: To ensure the commencement timescale for the development is not extended beyond that of the original planning permission granted on 05 Dec 2022 LBI ref: P2022/2739/FUL. Furthermore, to comply with the provisions of Section 91(1)(a) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 as amended by the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004 (Chapter 5).
